beats.event: Buck lives comfortably at Judge Miller's California estate
Kidnapped by a gardener and sold into the sled-dog trade
Transported to Seattle; beaten by man in red sweater
Learns 'the law of club and fang' the hard way
Trained as sled dog by Francois and Perrault
Rivalry with the lead dog Spitz builds on the trail
Buck kills Spitz in combat and becomes lead dog
Sold to a mail carrier; overworked on long routes
Sold to inexperienced stampeders Charles, Hal and Mercedes
Starving team collapses; most of the dogs die on the trail
John Thornton rescues Buck from Hal's beating
Thornton nurses him back to health; a deep bond forms
Buck wins bets for Thornton with feats of strength
Prospecting for gold together deep in the wilderness
Hears wolves calling; ventures out, but returns to camp
Returns to camp to find Thornton murdered by Yeehats
Joins the wolf pack; becomes the legendary Ghost Dog
